title: Archive a feature and its descendants
description: Moves a feature artifact and its transitive descendants from project-docs/ to project-docs/archive/, injecting an archive-reason frontmatter field. Shared Descendants (reachable from another feature) are left in place. When archiveReason is 'completed', a completeness guard runs first.

featurePath.description: Path to the feature artifact to archive (e.g. project-docs/features/my-feature.md).
featurePath.x-prompt: Path to the feature artifact to archive (e.g. project-docs/features/my-feature.md)?

archiveReason.description: Archive reason. 'completed' runs a completeness guard (all non-shared descendants must have a terminal artifact). 'deferred' skips the guard.
